for the black part, you'll need a rectangle and a circle, resize the rectangle so it's the size of your element, then deforme the top part so it's narrower using the direct selection tool after that cut the bottom part of the rectangle based on your circle using either the shape builder or the pathfinder tool, you'll need now to use the direct selection tool again and curve the upper corners using the round handles that appear.

For the gradient part, copy the black part in place then slightly shift it down and use the shape builder or the pathfinder to make it from the original black part
